notes: This is deciding whether a design document is ready for review by checking its writing quality, structure, and scope, not the system it describes. The proposal is meant to look credible, so a quick read can accept broad goals, a thin comparison, and confident scale language. The policy discussion and the scale claim need facts from the product brief and traffic or service files. The repeated decision and filler section can be found within the document, while the measurable goal also requires comparing the product brief.
